review.why: Audits and rewrites a LinkedIn profile with three scoring scripts and exit codes that say when to stop.
review.summary: Workflow to audit a LinkedIn profile, then rewrite the headline, About section and experience. Three Python scripts score the headline, audit completeness ranked by points per hour, and assemble the About section. A worksheet, an example input and two references are provided.
strengths: Scripts with exit codes give clear stop conditions
Fixes ranked by points per hour with a first-hour plan
Rules: never invent a credential or metric, nothing is scraped
cautions: LinkedIn only: no resume or ATS content
The scripts and references are described, not read in this review
Needs Python 3 and a profile JSON the user fills in
